text: This report recommends that the name "Chris Van Santen Lane" be approved to identify a public lane north of Queen Street East, extending westerly from Willow Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Chris Van Santen Lane" for a public lane located north of Queen Street East, extending westerly from Willow Avenue.
